messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: runtime.canary(us-west-2 · wave-3) p95 latency spike >1200ms for rwd-infer-api. No error-rate spike. Paging on-call.
oncall-alex: Ack, paging oncall. Jumping in now — which services and which canary wave?
maria-eng: wave-3 canary in us-west-2. p50 ~60ms -> ~350ms, p95 ~180ms -> ~1.2s. Throughput down ~28% on canary nodes. Kernel fallback logs show fallback to cpu_kernel_v1.
sam-sre: seeing KV cache miss rate up ~3x on that pool, batch window collapsed to microbatches (avg batch=1). Correlation with kernel-selector rollout: selector=v2 enabled 02:18 UTC for canary wave-3.
oncall-alex: Can we flip the kill-switch / feature flag for selector v2 in canary? We need fast mitigation.
maria-eng: Agreed. If selector v2 is causing an incompatible kernel path that forces CPU fallback for short sequences it explains both latency and batching collapse.
oncall-alex: @deploy-bot please apply feature-flag toggle: runtime.selector_v2 -> false for canary wave-3.
deploy-bot: Feature-flag change queued: /ff set runtime.selector_v2 false --scope=canary:wave-3
deploy-bot: Completed: runtime.selector_v2=false applied to canary:wave-3 at 16:23:47 UTC. Propagating to 6 instances.
maria-eng: Applied on nodes. p95 dropping to ~420ms after 30s, KV miss rate trending down. Continuing to monitor.
sam-sre: Trace snippet (samples):
```
2026-03-17T16:22:50Z node-03 kernel_selector: fallback->cpu_kernel_v1 seq_len=64 reason=kernel_not_supported_quantized
2026-03-17T16:22:51Z node-03 batch_coordinator: emit batch_size=1 window_ms=2
```
support-jordan: Customer impact note: enterprise customer "Fjord" reported increased latency for requests routed to canary; no errors or failed requests observed. We alerted support and impacted customers ~16:25 UTC. Estimated affected request share ~0.8% of total traffic during the spike window.
oncall-alex: Good catch. Maria/Sam — can eng-runtime take postmortem? Capture rollout metadata, kernel selector diffs, and workload traces. Oncall handing off.
eng-runtime: Taking it. Maria leading RCA, Sam supporting. We'll collect canary artifacts and S3 traces: s3://redwood-infer/incidents/1832101111/
maria-eng: Captured heap/traces, kernel selection logs, rollout id=rl-2026-03-17-0218, and a small set of representative requests. Starting postmortem doc and timeline.
oncall-alex: Mitigation successful. p95 back to ~80-120ms for canary, throughput recovering. Closing active page — leaving thread open for RCA and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
maria-eng: Noted. Will include recommended guardrail: reject selector rollout if KV miss > x or microbatch rate > y. Drafting follow-up.
oncall-alex: Thanks everyone. Please post RCA link here when ready and mark severity. Closing mitigation phase.
